investigate.note: Also imports data through artifact.rs (knowledge); the run itself is the agent loop.

verify.note: Unclear (could be agent, knowledge, or the visual gates it also checks). Kept in knowledge: it is the independent, program-run evidence check. This does not touch the pass-decision row: the matrix governs which group's tools may WRITE a pass record (agent only), and verify records a program-computed verdict, never one the model gives.

artifact_inventory.note: Reads artifacts of every group but only to help the model navigate; writes nothing.

newsroom_viz_plan.note: Cross-group write: records the chart claim and its computation record.

newsroom_viz_lint.note: Cross-group write: writes a computation record.

newsroom_editorial_discovery.note: Editorial research could be knowledge; kept with the page it feeds.

newsroom_story_graph.note: Story nodes cite claims, but the graph is a page-design record.

newsroom_visual_concepts.note: Also appends a tool-chain telemetry line (an agent artifact) from a visual tool.

newsroom_expert_preference_record.note: Write site where the model supplies a pass status. A review outcome, not drawing; stays visual for now, so the boundary check reports its pass record as cross-group.

newsroom_award_mode_status.note: Write site where the model supplies a pass status. Same call as newsroom_expert_preference_record.

newsroom_model_validate.note: Could be knowledge; decided visual because the record it gates is the spec the page draws.

newsroom_network_analyze.note: A computation (knowledge) that only serves drawing; the output path is under visualizations/.

newsroom_infographic_vision_critic.note: The model supplies passed and score: its own quality judgment of the rendered page, which is the product's design.
newsroom_infographic_vision_critic.verdict_reason: The publication decision is computed by the program from this verdict, so the critic itself writes a QA record and not the decision.

newsroom_competition_preflight.note: Machine preflight over the critics; the program computes machine_passed from the critics (the model passes only references), so no model-supplied pass is stored; it reads the model-supplied vision verdict as an input and writes a pass record.

newsroom_chart.note: In the registry but never registered; not model-visible.

newsroom_infographic_edit.note: Edits a visual plan though it is an agent-speed tool; decided visual because it writes a visual plan revision.

file_rules.note: Vendored chart library files; every file under this directory is drawing support.
Map boundary data for the map renderer; the name tables beside them (*.json) are listed one by one.

src/tool_registry.rs.note: Decides which tools the model sees; generated from runtime/pi/tool_registry.mjs.

src/pi.rs.note: Spawns Pi and sets the switches; also holds run-level gates.

src/repeat_failure.rs.note: V398: decides when a run stops after the same tool fails the same way five times (NEWSROOM_REPEAT_FAILURE_STOP, default off); changes no check.

src/step_lines.rs.note: Progress lines: display (system) fed by agent telemetry.

src/compose_answer.rs.note: A closing step (agent) written from verified claims and artifacts (knowledge).

src/artifact.rs.note: Data import, origins and source notes are knowledge; the run bundle storage is system.

src/verify.rs.note: Mostly evidence checks, but also render-QA, vision and publication gates.

runtime/pi/newsroom.ts.note: Tool registration and the run machinery are agent; the bodies of the knowledge, visual and system tools live in the same file. Not split.

runtime/pi/preflight.mjs.note: Page-stage preflight (opt-in) that reads visual state.

runtime/pi/fetch_split_probe.mjs.note: Report-only planner for splitting slow downloads (NEWSROOM_FETCH_SPLIT_PROBE); its diagnostic is written under runtime/, which the boundary report counts as agent-owned (cross_group).

runtime/pi/claim_binding.mjs.note: Checks a claim against a chart spec.

runtime/pi/economy_names.mjs.note: Name tables used by claims and by maps.

runtime/pi/story_graph.mjs.note: Story nodes cite claims; the graph is a page-design record.

runtime/pi/knowledge_writer.mjs.note: Writes the claim record, computation records and query-row tables on behalf of visual tools (hand-off switch).

runtime/pi/shadow_writer.mjs.note: Writes the shadow-check side files (shadow/, kind observation) on behalf of the visual-side tools (hand-off switch).

runtime/pi/probe_writer.mjs.note: Writes the fetch-split diagnostic files under runtime/fetch-split-probe/ on behalf of download_data (probe switch).

runtime/pi/decision_writer.mjs.note: Writes the expert-preference record, the award-mode status and the competition preflight, plus the vision-critic record (infographics/vision-critics/), on behalf of the visual-side tools (hand-off switch).

runtime/pi/agent_record_writer.mjs.note: Writes the refused-call store of the plan tool and the tool-chain event log on behalf of the visual-side tools (hand-off switch).

runtime/pi/extreme_probe.mjs.note: Report-only extreme-value probe of a drawn chart (NEWSROOM_EXTREME_PROBE=1); hands its diagnosis record to the agent-group writer. Also holds the caption note behind NEWSROOM_EXTREME_NOTE=1 (visual group, board item K117; delete when the note is installed as the default or K117 is dropped; writes no file).

runtime/pi/extreme_probe_writer.mjs.note: Writes the K117 diagnosis record under runtime/extreme-probe/ on behalf of the chart render tool.

runtime/pi/groups.mjs.note: Loader, boundary report and tool-order helpers for the group list.

evidence.what: claims, computation records, sources, searches, data files and origins, query-row tables

project_state.what: plan, run telemetry, rejected-call and patch stores, the run manifest (story.json)

visual_spec.what: chart, page, illustration, map, model-spec and publication specs, renders, critics, QA

observation.what: shadow-check side files: observations of the evidence that never become evidence themselves

pass_decision.what: review and award records, vision verdicts, competition preflight, chain-reuse records

run_record.what: run bundle bookkeeping the program writes: transcripts, event and metric logs, progress and the folder skeleton

verification_record.what: the program-computed result of the independent evidence check (verification.json)

materialized_runtime.what: the program's own code and assets copied into the run folder at start (runtime.rs materialize_extension): fixed names only, no Pi tool writes any of them

Written by the program (artifact.rs write_manifest) under an agent command: the run manifest. It lists the files and carries the delivery.primary_artifact the program found on disk, so it is run state of the agent group, not bookkeeping.
Written by the program (pi.rs) under an agent command, one line per finished tool call taken from the Pi tool_execution_end event: progress of the agent's plan.
Written by the program under verify (knowledge); continue (agent) also writes round status into it, but only a value the program computed with the verify calculation, never one the model supplies.
Written by the program (artifact.rs) under an agent command: the user's prompt copied as it was typed. System because the program copies it; nothing verifies against it.
Written by the program under an agent command: the model's final text copied to disk. A transcript the program stores (system); no check treats it as evidence.
Written by the program under investigate-v2: the model's final text copied to disk. A transcript (system), never evidence.
Written by the program under chat and continue: the turns copied to disk. A transcript (system), never evidence.
Written by the program (pi.rs) under an agent command: the Pi event log. The program records it, it grants nothing.
Written by the program (audit.rs) under an agent command: the tool-call audit the program counts from the event log.
Written by the program under an agent command: token and message counts from Pi.
Written by the program under an agent command: timing and token lines.
Written by the program under investigate-v2: measured timings of a visual story run.
